from AlgorithmImports import *


class ExactStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.sma100 = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.rsi14 = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_rsi = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        required_symbols = [
            self.spy,
            self.aapl,
            self.ibm,
            self.bac,
            self.aig
        ]

        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in required_symbols):
            self._update_state(data)
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
        spy_sma = self.sma100.Current.Value
        aapl_rsi = self.rsi14.Current.Value

        if not self.IsWarmingUp:
            if (
                self.sma100.IsReady
                and self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            ):
                crossed_above = (
                    self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                    and spy_close > spy_sma
                )
                crossed_below = (
                    self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                    and spy_close < spy_sma
                )

                if crossed_above and self.strategy_a_shares == 0:
                    quantity = int(
                        (0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close
                    )
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                        self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

                elif crossed_below and self.strategy_a_shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = 0

            if (
                self.previous_aapl_close is not None
                and aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close
            ):
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                    quantity = int(20000 / aapl_close)
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                        self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

            if (
                self.strategy_b_shares > 0
                and self.rsi14.IsReady
                and aapl_rsi > 60
            ):
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self._update_state(data)

    def _update_state(self, data):
        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy) and self.sma100.IsReady:
            self.previous_spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.sma100.Current.Value

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

            if (
                self.previous_aapl_close is not None
                and aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close
            ):
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

            if self.rsi14.IsReady:
                self.previous_aapl_rsi = self.rsi14.Current.Value

import math


class FixedStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        tickers = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        self.symbols = {
            ticker: self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol
            for ticker in tickers
        }

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.symbols["SPY"], 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.symbols["AAPL"], 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0
        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        required_symbols = list(self.symbols.values())

        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in required_symbols):
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.symbols["SPY"]]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.symbols["AAPL"]]

        spy_sma_before = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
        aapl_rsi_before = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value if self.aapl_rsi.IsReady else None

        self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)
        self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

        if (
            self.previous_aapl_close is not None
            and aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close
        ):
            self.aapl_red_streak += 1
        else:
            self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = spy_sma_before
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close
            return

        if (
            self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_bar.Close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            and self.strategy_a_shares == 0
        ):
            target_value = self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40
            quantity = math.floor(target_value / spy_bar.Close)

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], quantity)
                self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

        elif (
            self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_bar.Close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            and self.strategy_a_shares > 0
        ):
            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if (
            self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
            and self.strategy_b_shares == 0
            and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000
        ):
            quantity = math.floor(20000 / aapl_bar.Close)

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], quantity)
                self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        elif (
            self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60
            and self.strategy_b_shares > 0
        ):
            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
        self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
        self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

        self.pending_a_order = None
        self.pending_b_order = None

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        required_symbols = list(self.symbols.values())

        if any(not data.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in required_symbols):
            return

        spy_bar = data[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data[self.aapl]

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        current_spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
        current_spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
        current_aapl_rsi = float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value)

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            self.previous_spy_close = current_spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma
            self.previous_aapl_rsi = current_aapl_rsi
            return

        if (
            self.previous_spy_close is None
            or self.previous_spy_sma is None
            or self.previous_aapl_rsi is None
        ):
            self.previous_spy_close = current_spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma
            self.previous_aapl_rsi = current_aapl_rsi
            return

        spy_crosses_above = (
            self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and current_spy_close > current_spy_sma
        )

        spy_crosses_below = (
            self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and current_spy_close < current_spy_sma
        )

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and self.pending_a_order is None:
            if spy_crosses_above:
                target_value = 0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue
                quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / current_spy_close))

                if quantity > 0:
                    ticket = self.MarketOnCloseOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.pending_a_order = ticket.OrderId

        elif self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and self.pending_a_order is None:
            if spy_crosses_below:
                ticket = self.MarketOnCloseOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.pending_a_order = ticket.OrderId

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.pending_b_order is None:
            if current_aapl_rsi > 60:
                ticket = self.MarketOnCloseOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.pending_b_order = ticket.OrderId

        elif self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.pending_b_order is None:
            if (
                aapl_bar.Close < aapl_bar.Close * 0  # Never true; retained only to avoid reinterpretation
            ):
                pass

            if self._aapl_red_three_days():
                available_cash = self.Portfolio.Cash
                if available_cash >= 20000:
                    quantity = int(math.floor(20000 / float(aapl_bar.Close)))
                    if quantity > 0:
                        ticket = self.MarketOnCloseOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                        self.pending_b_order = ticket.OrderId

        self.previous_spy_close = current_spy_close
        self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma
        self.previous_aapl_rsi = current_aapl_rsi

    def _aapl_red_three_days(self):
        history = self.History[TradeBar](self.aapl, 4, Resolution.Daily)

        if history is None or len(history) < 4:
            return False

        closes = [float(bar.Close) for bar in history]
        return closes[-1] < closes[-2] and closes[-2] < closes[-3] and closes[-3] < closes[-4]

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent: OrderEvent):
        if orderEvent.Status != OrderStatus.Filled:
            return

        if orderEvent.OrderId == self.pending_a_order:
            self.strategy_a_lot += orderEvent.FillQuantity
            self.pending_a_order = None

        elif orderEvent.OrderId == self.pending_b_order:
            self.strategy_b_lot += orderEvent.FillQuantity
            self.pending_b_order = None
